review:
5 Lions Reborn brings back a fan-favourite series with a choice-based bonus. Three scatters activate it, and you pick from seven options combining up to 20 free spins and starting wild multipliers up to 15x.

Each time a win includes a wild, the wild multiplier increases by its starting value, and one to three extra spins may be added at random. Golden or Super scatters in the base game can trigger Free Spins or Super Free Spins; Super Free Spins start immediately with the maximum 20 spins and a 15x wild multiplier. The in-game screens advertise up to 5,000x. The RTP is 96.5%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
